notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.content:
- You can now unlock the tiger achievement with the convert rune stone.
- Small changes on text colors and interface
- Added a security check on filled level so EXIT / KEYS and other important items cant be overwritten anymore
- Hero's level now show "MAX" when you reach 12
- Chest won't spawn rune stone that is already for sell in merchant.
- empty jail bug fixed.
- Chinese language is now available.
- Added some missing french text

notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.content:
- Warcry rune stone does not slow the game anymore.
- Bounce rune stone is not working with Torch or Stones anymore.
- Invasion event : no longer freeze when invasion happens on level below 5.
- Jail no longer spawn if you unlock all characters.
- Wraith damage and life now displayed correctly on hint
- Unwilling ant : -2hp
